name: Jaylen Roman
source:
Jaylen is a hotly recruited Free Safety, drawing comps to Mathieu and Blount coming out of high school. Despite both image and effort concerns due to his passion for music, he’s proven to scouts repeatedly that his heart’s in the game until it isn’t.
